banking-economy.title: UK watchdog warns tech firms about AI agents offering regulated financial services
banking-economy.summary: Britain's Financial Conduct Authority has issued guidance for technology firms regarding AI agents and financial services. Firms must assess if their AI capabilities involve regulated activities and consult with regulators accordingly. This advisory follows Meta's launch of its Muse personal AI agent capable of several financial tasks. Moreover, users should be aware of the protections available to them while using these AI agents.
